page0.text:
"That's right, there's no way I can sleep like this."
A strategy against Gilgamesh.
If we are to face a cold-hearted enemy like that, we will end up with nothing but regret if we don't try to find an opportunity.

page1.text:
If we go to Ryudou Temple now, I'm sure someone is going to die.
Rather than end up with a regret like that, it's not a shame to try to do anything, to struggle until the very last moment.

page2.text:
"Tohsaka, are you still awake?"
I knock on her door.

page3.text:
"...! W-wait a minute, don't you dare come in right now!"
...Hm.
Knowing Tohsaka, I thought she would be sleeping by now, but it seems she's still awake.

page4.text:
Not only that, she's panicking.
I can hear her running around the room for something.
It seems she's finally calming down.
After a loud, deep breath that I can hear through the wall, she opens the door.

page5.text:
"And, what do you want?"
She glares at me as soon as we see each other.

page6.text:
"Well, it's to continue our conversation from earlier. I want to think more about how we can counter Gilgamesh."
...
...Huh.
Why are you staring me down like that?

page7.text:
"Tohsaka, are you in a really bad mood right now?"
I already know what she's going to say, but it doesn't hurt to ask.
"WHAT DO YOU THINK?"
She'd obviously yell at me, but I really am curious, so I end up asking her anyway.
However...

page8.text:
"...Never mind. It's not like I'm actually mad at you."
Well, now she's making me even more confused.

page9.text:
"Tohsaka, do you...have a fever or something?"
"No, I don't! Ugh, look, will you just come in? If you want to talk about Gilgamesh, then I actually wanted to go to your room and discuss something with you."

page10.text: Tohsaka drags me inside the room and locks the door. Then she slowly moves back into the room.

page11.text:
"...?"
Anyway, I start to move toward the center of the room.
Facing toward Tohsaka, I sit down across from her.

page12.text:
...
...
Silence.
She said she had something she wanted to talk to me about, yet she's not saying a word right now.

page13.text:
"Tohsaka, about Gilgamesh..."
"...I know. You're going to tell me you don't want to have Saber fight him, right? You're really considerate of her."

page14.text:
"Hold on, that's not what I'm talking about.
I'm simply saying that Gilgamesh is a bad match for Saber, so we should rethink our formation, that's all. If Saber is defeated and no one is left to slow him down, Tohsaka would be next."

page15.text:
"...Hmph. You said you want to change our current formation, but what exactly? I'm not going up against that Goldy.
He is taking advantage of his treasury and has anti-magecraft armor on.
He's a bad match for Saber, but an even worse match for me. Same for you."
